text:
Carla (AE): Quick sync — kicking off the Acme POC next week. They called out blockers: SSO (SAML2), SCIM provisioning (PATCH/filtering), RBAC mapping to AD groups, and domain-restricted signups. Need to confirm what we can do OOTB vs what needs eng help.
Mike (SE): Can you share IdP metadata and attribute expectations? e.g., audience, ACS, NameID format, which claim contains roles/groups? For SCIM: do they need filtering or complex patch operations?
Ajay - Acme IT: We can share metadata. NameID=email. Roles come in a claim called `roles` (comma-separated) and we also have group DNs for full sync. SCIM should support PATCH and filtering (we will send examples). Also want domain-lock so only *@acme.com can create accounts.
Beatrice (Security): A few security asks: must enforce SSO-only (no local passwords), SCIM audit logs exported, and SCIM over TLS mandatory. If possible, client certs for SCIM would be ideal. Also want retention of audit logs ~90 days.
Mike (SE): Quick answers: Hosted Redwood supports SAML SSO + SCIM v2 (list/create/update/delete) and group->role mapping. We consume `roles` claim or can map SCIM groups to Redwood roles. Audit events for SCIM and auth are available in Console (exportable). Client-cert TLS for SCIM is not supported on standard hosted plans — that typically requires Dedicated or Private deployment (we can detail options).
Carla (AE): Ajay — can you paste a minimal sanitized IdP metadata and the SCIM base URL here so we can wire it into the POC env tomorrow? Also confirm whether roles via SAML claim or SCIM is preferred.
Ajay - Acme IT: here's a sanitized metadata snippet (sensitive bits removed):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.com/" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata">
  <IDPSSODescriptor ProtocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://idp.acme.com/sso/post"/>
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM base: https://scim.acme.com/v2/
We prefer roles via SAML claim `roles`, but can fall back to SCIM group sync if needed.
Mike (SE): Perfect — thanks. For RBAC we'll apply a mapping table in the POC. Example mapping we'll use (sanitized):
```json
[
  {"scim_group":"acme-admins","redwood_role":"admin"},
  {"scim_group":"acme-developers","redwood_role":"developer"},
  {"saml_claim":"roles","match":"engineering","redwood_role":"developer"}
]
```
This handles either SCIM groups or SAML role claims.
deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned: p-acme-07. SAML ACS: https://p-acme-07.redwood.ai/saml/acs. SCIM proxy: https://p-acme-07.redwood.ai/scim/ (logs enabled).
Beatrice (Security): Couple follow-ups: confirm audit log retention (90 days ok?), who gets access to logs, and where logs are stored (we need SOC2 mapping). Also, if client-cert SCIM is a hard requirement we need Private/Dedicated details.
Carla (AE): Noted. Ajay — on pricing: rough usage estimate is ~10M tokens/month for the POC-to-production projection. Hosted usage + enterprise support would be our baseline quote; client-cert SCIM / VPC will push them to Dedicated/Private and change pricing. Mike — can you add the two deployment/pricing scenarios to the PRD?
Mike (SE): Will do. Option A: Hosted (SAML + SCIM via TLS) — fastest, lower cost. Option B: Dedicated/Private — adds client-cert SCIM, VPC, longer lead time, higher commit. I'll attach a short matrix.
Ajay - Acme IT: OK — I'll upload the full IdP metadata and a sample groups CSV to our shared folder: https://acme.share/sso/metadata.xml and https://acme.share/sso/groups.csv.
Carla (AE): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with Billing for a POC quote and schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Thanks everyone — we'll capture eng/ops tasks in the PRD and share before the call.
Beatrice (Security): I'll send the security questionnaire answers by EOD and flag any non-negotiables.
Mike (SE): I'll validate the SCIM PATCH examples against our POC env and confirm any gaps before the kickoff.
Carla (AE): Closing notes: action items: 1) Ajay — upload metadata + groups (done soon); 2) Mike — add deployment matrix + SCIM cert options; 3) Beatrice — sec questionnaire notes; 4) Carla/Billing — POC quote. See you tomorrow.
